question: Across the whole week in this data, which departure was the latest, and what was it blamed on?

content.text: I'll find the flight with the largest departure delay in the week.

input.sql: SELECT flight_id, tail_number, status, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, delay_carrier, delay_weather, delay_nas, delay_security, delay_late_aircraft, sched_dep_local, actual_dep_utc, sched_dep_utc FROM flights ORDER BY dep_delay_minutes DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) n, count(dep_delay_minutes) with_delay, max(dep_delay_minutes) mx FROM flights

SELECT flight_id, origin, destination, status, sched_dep_utc, actual_dep_utc, actual_arr_utc, dep_delay_minutes, arr_delay_minutes, delay_carrier, delay_late_aircraft FROM flights WHERE tail_number='N291WN' AND flight_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-01-02' ORDER BY sched_dep_utc

content.text:
**2026-01-01|WN|4285|SDF|BWI|0540** — tail **N291WN**, scheduled out of Louisville at 05:40 local (10:40Z), off the gate at 22:12Z, **692 minutes late (11h32m)**. It arrived BWI at 23:32Z, 677 minutes behind schedule. That is the worst departure in the week by a wide margin; the next-worst is 2026-01-01|WN|4500|CLE|MCO|0900 at 461 minutes.

The blame is entirely the carrier's own: all 677 minutes of arrival delay are coded **delay_carrier**, with zero weather, NAS, security, or late-aircraft. Note this was N291WN's first leg in the extract — there is no inbound leg on file for it (chain_breaks shows only an end_of_window break for that tail on 2026-01-07), so whatever caused the ~11.5-hour hold at SDF happened before the first observed flight and cannot be identified from this data. A maintenance or crew record would be needed to say more.

Downstream containment was good: the same tail's next leg, 2026-01-01|WN|1732|BWI|MCI|1930, went out only 34 minutes late (18 of those coded late_aircraft, 16 carrier) and arrived MCI 38 late. By the following morning the tail was back on schedule — 2026-01-02|WN|950|MCI|BNA|0710 departed 8 minutes early — so the 692-minute hit cost one downstream leg roughly half an hour and nothing after that.
